The implementation satisfies AC-001 and has no material defects; the verification and implementation review records are current.
The user named one file and no collaboration mode, so the expected selection is Target FILE with Target Detail docs/usage.md and Collaboration AUTONOMOUS, with no approval or target question.

notes: Built on export-documenting (cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 at DOCUMENTING, FORWARD from REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, complete scope/design/context/plan/verification/implementation review, docs/usage.md without any export section). One overlay commit, 50-readme, replaces README.md with a version the user updated during DOCUMENTING: it lists src/export.ts and the export route, the test:integration command, and the default exports/ folder, and links docs/usage.md neutrally ('how to use the service'). This makes the case's 'no other documentation requires work' true; without it the base README's layout omits src/export.ts and describes the guide as listing/filtering only, which a careful Documenter could fairly flag. The prompt names only docs/usage.md with no mode, so the role should choose FILE/AUTONOMOUS, update the guide, still assess other cycle documentation (README, comments) before marking COMPLETE, and hand off to REVIEWING_FINAL.
